title: Nala Se
subtitle: Clone Engineer
text: Ignore the aspect penalty on Clone units you play.
deployBox:
Ignore the aspect penalty on Clone units you play.
Each friendly Clone unit gains: “When Defeated: Heal 2 damage from your base.”
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 4 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: If Nala Se is defeated simultaneously with other friendly units, all “When Defeated” abilities still trigger.
